subject.title: feat(durable): add beta3 wake replay foundation

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor the opt-in durable wake and replay subsystem in core for the beta3 release line after its prerequisite foundation lands?
rationale: This introduces persistent core state, recovery policy, delivery semantics, and operator configuration; technical correctness alone cannot decide whether OpenClaw should own and ship that product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor staged adoption
options.body: Approve the direction, land the prerequisite first, and review this rebased slice with current-head upgrade and replay proof.

options.title: Narrow the boundary
options.body: Keep the work open but require a smaller owner-approved persistence and runtime surface before landing.

options.title: Decline core ownership
options.body: Close the durable stack if maintainers do not want core to own wake and replay semantics.

recommendation.title: Sponsor staged adoption
recommendation.body: Approve the direction, land the prerequisite first, and review this rebased slice with current-head upgrade and replay proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a repository-level core-scope and release-direction choice rather than a remaining mechanical code repair.
